doc: Settings and allow-list of the collision audit (tools/test/collision_audit_test.gd, docs/qa/COLLISION_AUDIT.md). 'allow' rules match on id (glob on the audit's id: kit:<id>, scene:<file>, house:<id>/<mesh>, mm:<multimesh>, node:<path>, blocker#n, box#n(mat)), path (glob on the node path under the area) and class (a script class among the node's ancestors). allow: all = walk-through on purpose; partial = only its core is solid on purpose; invisible = a collider with nothing drawn on purpose; surface = a water or ice sheet; undrawn = light, smoke, sky. Never add a rule to make the audit pass: a thing the player expects to bump into is an offender.

allow.reason: grass, heather and sedge clumps: ground cover the Bearer wades through
grass growing on the turf roofs, overhead
sea, river, tarn and bog sheets (and the same sheets frozen): a surface, never a wall

a tree's trunk is the solid (Forest._tree_bodies); boughs and needles brush past
